```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Example native DataFrame; replace with your own.
df_native = pd.DataFrame({"spend": [500, 1500, 999, 1000]})

df = nw.from_native(df_native, eager_only=True)

df = df.with_columns(
    nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
    .then(nw.lit("gold"))
    .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
    .alias("tier")
)

result = nw.to_native(df)
print(result)
```
